name: New Day resets Paragon, Chosen of the Light and Judgement Day through a native Ascension effect (#3920)
contract: Spell.dbc 800600 ("New Day") has three SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN (195) effects with EffectMiscValue 680639, 800622 and 806121 and EffectMiscValueB 1 — those three ids resolve (SpellName_1 in Spell.dbc) to 'Paragon', 'Chosen of the Light' and 'Judgement Day', exactly the tooltip's list. SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN is a generic Ascension core effect (SharedDefines.h:1016; wired into the effect table at SpellEffects.cpp:267); Spell::EffectAscensionResetCooldown (SpellEffects.cpp:541-550) calls ResetAscensionCooldown(player, effect.MiscValue, effect.MiscValueB != 0), which does player->RemoveSpellCooldown(spellId, true) and, since MiscValueB is nonzero, also clears the spell's category cooldown. This is a fully generic, already-wired native effect handler that reads the exact spell ids straight out of the DBC record; no server script exists or is needed.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Chosen of the Light is on cooldown
New Day resets Chosen of the Light's cooldown
New Day resets Judgement Day's cooldown
